biography.plain_text: Andrew White is a British sports marketing entrepreneur who founded WSM Communications and sold the agency to Bill Gates's Corbis group. He later established 5Oceans Partnership and became an investor in sports and health technology businesses. He studied geography at the University of the West of England before entering the industry.

long_biography.plain_text:
Sports entrepreneur Andrew White co-founded the Institute of Sports Humanities to develop people working in sports leadership. Its postgraduate teaching combines strategy and decision-making with the history, governance and social context of sport. Designed for professionals studying alongside their jobs, its courses bring together people from different parts of the industry.

He also helped the Bahamas Olympic Committee rebuild its website, drawing on his business network to provide resources for the project. The overhaul added audiovisual material and access to the Olympic Channel, giving audiences a way to follow local athletes and international events. The committee retained its written history within the redesigned site.
